Prototype 11 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (62%), with EOG (27%) and EMG (10%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+2.6 dB, sensitivity=7.8) and elevated γ (+2.7 dB, sensitivity=4.1).
The δ activity is present in 29% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (SEM 34% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, EOG quiescent; missing: σ relevant.
